title: 第3章  契约第一只御兽第4章  准备挖人的老师
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
地中海老师站起身来，用不可思议的目光看着凌沧海。
“s级天赋？”
“这怎么可能！”
“沧澜高中上一次出现s级御兽师的苗子，根据记载是在三百年前，你们七班那种吊车尾的班级，怎么可能出现s级御兽师的苗子。”
地中海老师在说话的同时，目光看向凌沧海放在桌子上的御兽师天赋觉醒报告，在看到报告上第一个名字夜离殇，天赋s级，以及重点培养几个字的时候，他的眼眸不由自主地紧缩了一下。
“差班？”
“吊车尾？”
凌沧海的脸色逐渐冷了下来，道：“我们七班的平均成绩虽然是低了一点，但这不代表，我们班中没有优秀的学生，也不代表我们班中不能出现一个优秀的学生。”
“主任，我觉得应该把这名学生放到我们优秀班级中进行培养，放到差班中，有可能会不利于这名学生的成长。”
地中海老师没有理会凌沧海的话语，而是将目光看向拿起报告查看的主任。
“早干嘛去了？”
“当初分班级前，你干嘛去了？”
“现在看人家天赋好，就想要挖到自己班级去，我问你凭什么？”
“主任，这个事情我坚决反对。”
“我的教导水平要远高于他，想要挖走的学生，我是坚决不同意的。”
凌沧海淡淡扫了一眼地中海老师，同样将目光看向主任。
“夜离殇……不错的名字。”
主任缓缓放下手中的报告，双手交叉在一起，看着面前的两位老师。
“无规矩不成方圆。”
“学院有学校的规矩，班级没有高低之分，在哪学习不是学习，不能为了自己的业绩，就不考虑学生的感受，我们做老师也要尊重学生的意愿，除非学生自己表示所在班级的老师不适合教导自己，否则我是不提倡将学生来回换班级的举动。”

“现在是上课时间，都回去给学生们上课吧。”
主任轻轻摆摆手。
闻言，地中海似乎是想说些什么，但想了想，终究没有说出口，而是和凌沧海一同走出了主任的办公室。
……
高三七班。
一声清脆的破碎声在夜离殇面前响起。
呜嘤～
一声带着几分奶萌的声音，传入夜离殇的耳中。
夜离殇睁开眼眸，看着眼前这只体型跟小猫差不多，毛发雪白，生有两只小巧兽耳，一条雪白左右摆动的云绒狐，眼眸一下子就亮起来了。
“好……好可爱。”
夜离殇伸出一根手指，小心翼翼地触碰云绒狐的兽耳，软软的触感从指尖传来，手感非常好。
呜嘤～
云绒狐轻轻叫唤一声，主动轻蹭起夜离殇的手。
“叫声也好软呀。”
夜离殇小心翼翼地将云绒狐抱在怀中，轻轻抚摸着，嘴角不自觉地露出笑容。
坐在前排的洛星燃，抽空往后方看了一眼，不由得撇撇嘴，继而继续温养起玄甲水犀的御兽蛋。
很快，玄甲水犀的蛋也破碎开来，一只体型在三十公分左右，身体仿佛披着蓝色铁甲，外形酷似小犀牛的玄甲水犀出现在洛星燃的面前。
“嗯～好像不怎么好看。”
洛星燃看看自己的玄甲水犀，又悄悄瞄了一眼夜离殇抱在怀中的云绒狐，在心中默默比较着。
最终得出一个结论。
content_en:
Teacher Mediterranean stood up and looked at Ling Canghai with incredible eyes.
"S-level talent?"
"How is this possible!"
"The last time an S-level beast master appeared in Canglan High School was three hundred years ago, according to records. How could a S-level beast master appear in a class like yours, Class 7, which is at the bottom of the class?"
While Teacher Mediterranean was speaking, he looked at the beastmaster talent awakening report that Ling Canghai placed on the table. When he saw the first name on the report, Ye Li Shang, with an S-level talent, and the words "key training", his eyes involuntarily tightened.
"Easy shift?"
"Crane tail?"
Ling Canghai's face gradually turned cold and he said: "Although the average score of our Class 7 is a bit lower, it does not mean that there are no outstanding students in our class, nor does it mean that there cannot be an outstanding student in our class."
"Director, I think this student should be placed in our excellent class for training. Putting him in a poor class may be detrimental to this student's growth."
Teacher Mediterranean ignored Ling Canghai's words, but looked at the director who picked up the report and looked at it.
"What did you do early?"
"What were you doing before we were divided into classes?"
"Now that I see someone with good talent, I want to recruit him into my own class. Why do I ask you?"
"Director, I firmly oppose this matter."
"My teaching level is much higher than his. I firmly disagree with the students who want to poach them."
Ling Canghai glanced at Teacher Mediterranean lightly, and also looked at the director.
"Ye Li Shang... a good name."
The director slowly put down the report in his hand, crossed his hands together, and looked at the two teachers in front of him.
"Nothing can be done without rules."
"The college has the rules of the school. There is no distinction between high and low classes. Studying anywhere is not learning. You cannot ignore the feelings of students for the sake of your own performance. As teachers, we must also respect the wishes of students. Unless the students themselves express that the teacher in the class is not suitable to teach them, I do not advocate the move of students to change classes back and forth."
"It's class time now, go back and teach the students."
The director waved his hand gently.
Hearing this, Mediterranean seemed to want to say something, but after thinking about it, he did not say it out loud. Instead, he and Ling Canghai walked out of the director's office.
…
Class 7, Grade 3.
A crisp breaking sound sounded in front of Ye Li Shang.
Woohoo~
A somewhat cute voice came into Ye Lishang's ears.
Ye Lishang opened his eyes and looked at the fox that was about the size of a kitten, with snow-white hair, two small animal ears, and a snow-white cloud velvet fox swinging from side to side, and his eyes suddenly lit up.
"So... so cute."
Ye Lishang stretched out a finger and carefully touched the Yunrong Fox's animal ear. The soft touch came from the fingertips and it felt very good.
Woohoo~
Yunrong Hu called softly and took the initiative to rub Ye Lishang's hand.
"The cry is so soft."
Ye Lishang carefully held Yunrong Fox in his arms, caressing it gently, and smiled unconsciously at the corner of his mouth.
Luo Xingran, who was sitting in the front row, took the time to glance behind him, curled his lips, and continued to warm the black-armored water rhino's egg.
Soon, the egg of the black-armored water rhinoceros also broke open, and a black-armored water rhinoceros about thirty centimeters in size, whose body seemed to be covered in blue iron armor and looked like a small rhinoceros, appeared in front of Luo Xingran.
"Hmm~ It doesn't look very good."
Luo Xingran looked at his Black-armored Water Rhinoceros, and then quietly glanced at the Yunrong Fox held in Ye Lishang's arms, silently comparing them in his mind.
Finally come to a conclusion.
